scenario: [RFCS.3.1] classes `TypeError` and `ComputationError` as `compare`, so [LFST.9.3.1] byte-compares each re-derived one with the recorded one, and its `timetag` by pairing ([LFST.9.3.6]). `typed` reads `p.body.name`, a String, with `>`: a TypeError ([LERR.1.3.1]). `trap` divides by a slot holding 0: a ComputationError ([LEXP.7.15.1]). A run holding both replays into a fresh engine with no divergence. This vector does not check that the recording holds them: `LFST.9.3.1_a_recorded_type_error_differs` and `LFST.9.3.1_a_recorded_computation_error_differs` run the same rules with an edit that has no site unless it does ([RCTS.1.2.18]), and those and the `_taken_out` vectors are the edited recordings. Break: an encoder that wrote a field that is a function of the replaying process makes this replay diverge. PATH PINNED: libds's `verify_capture_sink` and `verify_match` (rfcs/codec.c), through pyds `Engine.record` / `Engine.replay` in runner.py `_replay_through_libds_rfcs`; the Mercury runtime's `ds.rfcs.lfst_9_3_1_compared` and `ds.replay.lfst_9_3_1_match`, through test_behave.m `replay_determinism_result`.
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    body: Json key

schema S scope logical:
    k: Int key
    a: Int mutable
    b: Int mutable

rule typed:
    Payload p where p.body.name > 5
->
    log info "typed"

rule trap:
    S s where s.a // s.b > 1
->
    log info "trap"
